question.text: The most likely acid-catalysed aldol condensation products of each of the two aldehydes I and II will respectively be

solution.text:
\(\left[F e F_{6}\right]^{3-}\) complex ion possesses sp \(^{3} d^{2}\) hybridization.

The electronic configurations of \(C r, F e, C o\) and \(T i\) in the complexes are \((3 d)^{3},(3 d)^{5},(3 d)^{6}\) and \((3 d)^{1}\), respectively.

These involve \(d^{2} s p^{3}, s p^{3} d^{2}, d^{2} s p^{3}\) and \(d^{2} s p^{3}\) hybridization respectively.
